content: Me Nasaleta Yesu siguitoyasena
Ta Yesu ꞌiila tauna ꞌina ꞌasaya, ga ꞌina tononoyao simuliyena.

Ga Sabateya ꞌidi anuwa tapwalolo ꞌena ꞌilugu ga ꞌitoolo ta ꞌieꞌieꞌita ga tomota sinonona, ta yauyaudi nuwadi ꞌiowana ꞌina mwalatoi be ꞌina guinuwa manudi, ga sigwae, “Tai gete mane ꞌenega ꞌina sinasinapu ꞌilobena? Ta wate guinuwa nidi waiwaidi nimanega ꞌiguinuwedi, mane ꞌenega ꞌina waiwai ꞌilobena?”
Ta wate sigwae, “Tai gete toꞌabiꞌabi tuga aga? Ta sinana Meli, be tasinao Yemesa be Yosese be Yudasa be Saimoni be wate nuunao maꞌedao tamiyami, aga?” ꞌEnega tomota Yesu siguitoyasena.
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Palopitao ꞌadi ꞌamayaba silobaloba mali ꞌasa ꞌediya. Ta taudi ꞌidi ꞌasaya esiya nigeya ꞌadi ꞌamayabamo, manuna taudi ꞌidi buꞌunao be ꞌidi susuyao siguitoyasedi.”
Ta Yesu nuwana ꞌiowana manuna tomota nigeya siemiemise, ꞌenega nigeya kapekapeyana be guinuwa waiwaina bada ꞌida guinuwedi. Nate namo toleꞌoasao puꞌepuꞌedimo ꞌigitoodi ga siboboꞌana.
Yesu ꞌina tononoyao ꞌietunedi sabi paisewa
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌisakowasi ꞌasa ꞌediya ta ꞌieꞌieꞌita.

Ga ꞌina tononoyao site tuwelo ꞌibwauyedi ga ꞌiloinedi be ꞌaene ꞌeluwa ꞌeluwa sida sakowasi ꞌasa ꞌediya, ta wate loina be waiwai ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi be ꞌenega sawesawediya yaluyaluwa biꞌi tomota ꞌediyega sida ula apwesedi,
ga ꞌina guguya ꞌenaya ꞌiloinedi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu toꞌase waꞌewaꞌewa. Geyaꞌabo masula nai tana nai mani ꞌabwaga manuna. Nate namo ꞌimi ꞌetoguna nimamiya,
be ꞌami ꞌaelawa waꞌotedi, ta esi geyaꞌabo ꞌami ꞌoama ꞌeluwena waꞌoteꞌotedi.”
Ta wate ꞌieonedi, “ꞌEguma to anuwa ꞌena sibwauyemi be ꞌena walulugu, anuwa nina ꞌena waeꞌowaga be ꞌana laba sena nina wapilisine.

Ta saꞌi ꞌeguma ꞌasa ꞌaina ꞌediya waapwesa be tomota nidi nigeya siꞌauꞌauꞌewami ꞌidi anuwa ꞌediya be wate nigeya ꞌimi guguya sinoonodi, ꞌasa nidi nedilina ꞌaemiyega waloutuutu yauledi ta wapilisinedi, be ꞌenega waeꞌitadi ꞌaene ꞌiabe mwau ꞌediya ꞌiapwesa.”
ꞌEnega ꞌina tononoyao nidi sisakowasi ꞌasa yaudi ꞌediya, ga siguguya be ꞌaene tomota ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalidi sida guitoyasedi be sida nuwaꞌebuni,
ga yaluyaluwa biꞌi tomota ꞌediyega siula apwesedi, ga toleꞌoasao yaudi wate bunamega sieꞌabidi ga siboboꞌana.
Yoni togiebapitaiso ꞌina mwawasa

ꞌEnega Yesu tetelina tomota silelewanena sena yauyauna ꞌediya ga Kini Elodi ꞌinonona. Manuna ꞌaina tomota sionaona ꞌaene “Yoni togiebapitaiso mwawasega niꞌatu ꞌitoolo limana ꞌenega ma ina waiwai ꞌiguiguinuwa.”
Ta ꞌaidi siona ꞌaene, “Tauna Ilaitiya.” Ta ꞌaidi wate sigwae, “Tauna palopita ꞌebweu ꞌatuwa gimi palopitao.”
Elodi wate niꞌatu tetela ꞌinonona ga ꞌigwae, “Nai tauna Yoni togiebapitaiso. Lowa yaloemwawasina ta saꞌi ꞌitoolo limanaya.”
Manuna lowa Elodi Yoni ꞌigiyaina ga deliya ꞌiyonina, ta Yoni ꞌana giyai ꞌalena nate ꞌebweu waine ꞌana esana Elodiyasa, nate Elodi tasina Pilipi mwanena ta Elodi ꞌiꞌoayena,
ta Yoni Elodi ꞌieonena ꞌaene, “Gote nigeya bubuna boboꞌana, manuna tasiyo mwanena ꞌuꞌoayena.”
Ta Yoni ꞌina guguya gete manuna waine nina ꞌinuwa mwau ꞌaiꞌaila ga nuwanuwana be Yoni ꞌida loemwawasi, ta nigeya sawesawenaya

manuna Elodi ꞌiegagalena ꞌaene Yoni nina tai palupaluna ta Yaubada ꞌina toguinuwa ꞌebweu, ꞌenega Elodi Yoni ꞌiꞌamayabena ga tuta yauna Elodi nuwanuwana ga Yoni ꞌina ona ꞌinonona ta manuna ꞌiꞌatesaꞌala.

ꞌEnega Elodi nina ꞌina ꞌasiyata tubuwa ꞌiapwesa ga Elodiyasa niꞌatu ꞌeda ꞌinuwa lobena Yoni ꞌana loemwawasa manuna. ꞌAsiyata tubuwa nina ꞌana weꞌiweꞌiyaya masulina siguinuwena ga ꞌaina ꞌowaga sibwauyedima sabi ꞌemasula. ꞌOwagao nidi gabemani ꞌadi toloinao be tolosaiya ꞌadi toanuganao ta ꞌaidi Galili ꞌasanao ꞌidi ꞌinapwanao.

Tuta nina Elodi ma ꞌana ꞌowagao siꞌeꞌai, Elodiyasa natuna mewainena ꞌiluguma matadiya ga lausega ꞌigie gwausowalidi. ꞌEnega Elodi gomagweine nina ꞌena ꞌiona oboboma ꞌaene “ꞌEguma to yage ꞌuesinuwa be ꞌusidegu yada tagwala ꞌemuya.”
Ga wate ꞌiona upaupa sawatamatamana ꞌenega ꞌigwae, “Onaꞌaiꞌaila yaona upaupa toꞌase nai yada ꞌebwaꞌeyo, ꞌeguma nai ꞌuda sida be ꞌaene ꞌigu ꞌebeloina yada weyali manuyo.”

ꞌEnega gomagweine nina ꞌiapwesa ga ꞌitauya sinana ꞌena ꞌienaida, ꞌigwae, “Sinagu, toꞌase ꞌimu nuwanuwa be kini ꞌenaya yada side?” Ta sinana ꞌigwae, “Kini ꞌueona ꞌugwae, ‘Nuwanuwagu Yoni togiebapitaiso bulubuluna.’ ”
ꞌEnega gomagweine ꞌilomanini ga ꞌiila kini ꞌena ga ꞌigwae, “Nuwanuwagu gete tuga Yoni togiebapitaiso bulubuluna gaeba ꞌena ꞌusaꞌu be ꞌuꞌebwaꞌegu.”
Ta Elodi ꞌinuwamwau ꞌaiꞌaila, ta nigeya kapekapeyana be ꞌiguitoyase, manuna niꞌatu ꞌisawa tamatamana ꞌowagao matadiya.
ꞌEnega deli ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌebweu ꞌiloinena be ꞌaene ꞌida tauya be Yoni bulubuluna ꞌida meꞌe. Ga ꞌenega toꞌitaꞌiꞌita nina deliya ꞌitauya ga Yoni ꞌotona ꞌiꞌupwena,
ga bulubuluna gaebaya ꞌiusena ga ꞌimeꞌena, ga gomagweine nina ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena, ta tauna ꞌiꞌewena ga ꞌitauyena sinana ꞌenaya.
Ta Yoni ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌina esilae tetelina sinononaya ga simai ga Yoni kokowana siꞌewena, ga sisaꞌu ꞌaliꞌaliyena.
Yesu pwalu ꞌieꞌenidi
Ta niꞌatu Yesu ꞌina topaisewao site tuwelo siilama ga Yesu ꞌena ꞌidi paisewa be ꞌidi eꞌita maiboꞌana sisimanedi.

Ta tomota yau wawasae simeemai ta siilaila ga ꞌenega nigeya kapekapeyana be Yesu ma ina tononoyao sieyawaiꞌata be siꞌaꞌa, ꞌenega ꞌieonedi ꞌigwae, “Sena getei tada pilisine be tada tauya sena mwatui daitaya be gote ꞌena tupwana waeyawaiꞌata.”
ꞌEnega taudimo waga sigeluna ga sitauya ꞌebweu sena mwatui daitaya.
Ta pwalu nidi Yesu ma ina tononoyao ꞌidi gelu siꞌitena ga siꞌinanedi, ꞌenega taudi be ꞌasa yaudi ꞌadi tomiyanao wate maꞌediyao ꞌedega sipili ga sigimiapwesa sena gote ꞌenaya.

Ta muliyega waga ꞌilugu ga Yesu ꞌisuya dabalaya ga boda sinabwana kaukauya ꞌiꞌitedi, ta ꞌiꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyedi manuna taudi ꞌatuwa nadigega sipiyao nigeya ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌitamo, ꞌenega ꞌilolagata ga sinasinapu yauna ꞌieꞌieꞌita ꞌediya.
Ga ꞌasuinuwanuwaya ꞌina tononoyao simai ga Yesu sieonena, sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, sena gete mwatui daita ta niꞌatu sinala ꞌisugusuguwa,
ꞌenega pwalu getedi ꞌuda etunedi be sida ila be ꞌadi masula sida gimwane ꞌasao be anuwao selabediya ꞌediya.”

Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Ta mwaꞌadega? ꞌOmi geyaꞌabo waeꞌenidi, aga?” Ta ꞌina tononoyao sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, nigeya sawesawemaya, manuna maiboꞌadi ꞌadi masula ꞌana maisa nai tu analedi kina nadigega.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “ꞌEisa beledi ꞌemiya? Watauya be waꞌebesa.” ꞌEnega niꞌatu silobena ga Yesu sieonena, sigwae, “Beledi nima ta iyana ꞌeluwa ꞌalobedi.”
ꞌEnega pwalu ꞌiloinedi be maiboꞌadi simiyatowa boda be boda pwatulaya.
ꞌEnega siweyalidi ga simiyatowa, ꞌaina boda tomota ꞌadi yau analedi, be ꞌaina boda tomota ꞌadi yau pipiti nadigega.

Ta beledi nima be iyana ꞌeluwa ꞌiꞌewedi ga galewaya ꞌiꞌitatuꞌe ta ꞌiona oboboma masula nidi manudi, ga muliyega beledi ꞌigitomwedi ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi be sida eguyaiye tomota ꞌediya. Wate iyana nadigega ꞌigitomwedi ga ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi ta ꞌenega sieguyaiyedi.
ꞌEnega maiboꞌadi siꞌai ga gamwadi ꞌipawa.
Ta beledi be iyana tupwatupwadi siegogonedi ga kodo tuwelo siloemaedi.
Toꞌeꞌai nidi taidimo ꞌadi yau paibi tausani nadigega.
Yesu ola debanega ꞌitautauya
Ta muliyega ꞌina tononoyao ꞌiloinedi be wagaya sigegelu, ꞌigwae, “Wagegelu be wanugana Betesaida mali esenaya, ta ꞌaboꞌagu bada ꞌetamo boda yaemataluwedi be siila ꞌidi ꞌasaya.”
ꞌEnega sigelu ta Yesu pwalu ꞌietunediya, ta muliyega ꞌituꞌe ꞌoyaya sabi sidasida Yaubada ꞌena.
Ga niꞌatu ꞌiboi, ta ꞌina tononoyao bwagabwagaya siꞌadaꞌadau, ta tauna saꞌi tebweuna dabalaya
ꞌiꞌitedi ꞌidi neya ꞌenega siloꞌameꞌame manuna yagila matadiyega ꞌimeema. Ta tomwa uliulitaya Yesu ola debanega ꞌitauyama be ꞌaene selabediyega ꞌialogedo be ꞌida pilisinedi.
Gote ꞌena ꞌina tononoyao maiboꞌadi Yesu siꞌitena ola debanega ꞌimeemai ga sinuwena ꞌaene welabana,
ꞌenega simatauta ga sinanala. Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Geyaꞌabo wamatamatauta. ꞌAboꞌagu tuga, ꞌimi ꞌinapwana.”
Ga wagaya ꞌigelu maꞌenao ga yagila ꞌipela.

Ta nuwadi ꞌiowana sinabwana, manuna Yesu ꞌina waiwai manuna nigeya sinuwanuwa sabwaleni. ꞌEguma tuta nina tomota yaudi ꞌadi beledi Yesu ꞌieguyai be ꞌalena sida mwalatoni be ꞌenega sida nuwasabwaleni, ta tuga nigeya simwalamwalatoni, manuna debapaꞌalidi.
Toleꞌoasao ꞌigie boboꞌanedi sena Genesaleta ꞌena
ꞌEnega siabala sena Genesaleta ꞌenaya ga leꞌawinaya silugu ga ꞌidi waga gote ꞌena siloomuna.
Ga tuta nina sisuya toniꞌasa Yesu siꞌinanena,
ta ꞌenega tomota nidi sipili ga sitauya ꞌasa maiboꞌana ꞌediya ga toleꞌoasao simeꞌedi ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌediyega be Yesu ꞌena sitauyedi to sena ꞌena sinonona ꞌimiyami.

Ga Yesu ꞌisakowasi sena yauyauna ꞌediya, ꞌaina ꞌasa sinabwadi be ꞌasa gidalidi be ꞌebe bagula ꞌediya. Ta tomota yaudi ꞌidi toleꞌoasao simeꞌedi ga ꞌebe gimwane ꞌediya siyamwayamwa ta sisidena sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, kapekapeyana be toleꞌoasao getedi ꞌamu ꞌoama tupitupinamo sida gitoo?” Ga Yesu ꞌediya ꞌitagwala. ꞌEnega taudi ꞌana ꞌoama sigitoona siboboꞌana.
